pages.title: Station Terminal
pages.text: Monitoring stations keep a sealed back room. The terminal opens it.$(br2)Crack the password once and the door stays open, along with the station's records.

pages.title: Cracking It
pages.text: The screen hides $(bold)7 words$() in junk symbols. Pick one.$(li)A wrong word shows how many letters sit in the right place$(li)$(bold)4 tries$(), then a $(danger)45 s lockout$()$(br2)Matched brackets in the junk remove a dud or restore your tries.

pages.title: ORSA IT Notice
pages.text: $(flavor)Station passwords rotate weekly. Staff are reminded not to leave them on sticky notes, in the logbook, or on the terminal itself.$()
